name: fangorn-index
description: For people and agents finding data on Fangorn. The fangorn MCP server downloads the Fangorn explorer's view (every publisher, indexed) and searches it locally, so queries stay private: search records, list publishers, get one, buy what is sold (FANGORN_MCP_WALLET_KEY, up to FANGORN_MCP_MAX_PRICE a record), and publish your own.
